_comment: #2424, #3881 (ADR-0013: PR feedback p90 <= 15 min, and no PR job over 8 min): the services/api pytest lanes that .github/workflows/_job-py.yml runs in parallel. Paths are relative to services/api. Every lane runs the same marker expression, flags and --cov as the single job did, restricted to its paths. A heavy lane is sharded into lanes of their own (unit-heavy-1..4), and a directory can be shared: a path one lane lists inside another lane's path is carved out of it, so the outer lane keeps what no lane lists, a new subdirectory too. The rest lane runs tests/ minus every path listed below, so a new test directory always runs somewhere. Rebalance by moving paths between lanes (python tools/ci/py_test_lanes.py estimate LOG... sums each lane's run time from CI job logs) and keep the workflow's matrix in step: scripts/tests/test_py_test_lanes.py fails when a test file would run in no lane or in two, when a listed path no longer exists, or when the matrix and this file name different lanes.
